gms.description: Native GMS Data Layer between watch and phone (no PC). Both SHM apps share package and signing certificate.

alarm.description: Fork of the watch Alarm app (AlarmWatch 1.3.05.5) that receives phone alarms from the SHM bridge over direct intents instead of the GMS Data Layer. No launcher icon, own label.

shm-region-countrylist.title: Country list
shm-region-countrylist.description: Boolean country check ("BH" in list) -> true

shm-force-update-response.title: Update check response
shm-force-update-response.description: AppVersionCheckResponse: failed/updateNeeded -> false; non-null version (the watch response can come back failed without versionName and the NPE kills the process mid-handshake)

shm-force-update-pref.title: Forced update flag
shm-force-update-pref.description: Method reading the required-version pref -> false

shm-setup-network-gate.title: Setup network gate
shm-setup-network-gate.description: checkNoNetworkError -> void (no SIM/region gate in setup)

phone-rebrand-gms.title: Phone package rebrand
phone-rebrand-gms.description: Phone: package -> com.samsung.android.shealthmonitors (same package and certificate as the watch app: the GMS Data Layer only delivers between equal AppKeys)

watch-rebrand-coexist.title: Watch package rebrand
watch-rebrand-coexist.description: Watch: package -> shealthmonitors (manifest, permissions, authorities, tile package) so it coexists with the system app

watch-queries-health-service.title: Health service visibility
watch-queries-health-service.description: Watch: manifest <queries> declares com.samsung.android.service.health (package visibility for the Health Tracking Service)

watch-companion-vendor.title: Companion vendor
watch-companion-vendor.description: Watch: accept any companion vendor ("samsung" match forced; READ_COMPANION_INFO denial path -> TRUE)

watch-alarm-system-app.title: Exact alarm scheduling
watch-alarm-system-app.description: Watch: setExactAlarmForSystemApp lookup renamed -> stock setAlarmClock path

watch-mobile-installed.title: Phone app installed
watch-mobile-installed.description: Watch: "phone app installed" getter -> true (opens the ECG capability gate)

body: # PATCH: always report the phone app as installed (capability_ecg gate)

watch-ecg-sensor-adapter.title: ECG sensor
watch-ecg-sensor-adapter.description: Watch: ECG sensor (0x1b) via EcgAdapter (Health Tracking SDK) + availability exemption for IHRN (0x25) and SpO2/apnea (0x31)

watch-sensor-unregister-compat.title: Sensor unregister compatibility
watch-sensor-unregister-compat.description: Watch: every SemSensorManager.unregisterListener(listener, int) call goes through WatchOverrides, which picks the overload the watch framework has (Galaxy Watch8 lacks this one and SHM closed on open)

watch-apnea-country.title: Apnea country check
watch-apnea-country.description: Watch: apnea country check -> true (regional check disabled)

insert: const-string v1, "isApneaSupportCountry : regional check disabled (vendor override)"

watch-apnea-reeval-not-supported.title: Apnea support re-evaluation
watch-apnea-reeval-not-supported.description: Watch: persisted NOT_SUPPORTED apnea version is re-evaluated

alarm-verify-symbols.title: Link dependencies
alarm-verify-symbols.description: Link dependencies (o2.b/o2.c JSON model, k0.b local broadcast, AlarmSyncService.m) exist

alarm-rebrand-manifest.title: Fork package rebrand (manifest)
alarm-rebrand-manifest.description: Manifest: package, dynamic-receiver permission and provider authorities -> fork package

alarm-rebrand-code.title: Fork package rebrand (code)
alarm-rebrand-code.description: Smali: content URI (u2/b) and exact package strings (c0/c, J0/e, e2/i, Z1/b) -> fork package

alarm-permissions-prune.title: Privileged permissions
alarm-permissions-prune.description: Manifest: drop privileged/system uses-permission and the vendor permission declarations

alarm-queries-libs.title: Queries and libraries
alarm-queries-libs.description: Manifest: drop <queries> and the wear-sdk/window/appfunctions libs; wearable lib optional

alarm-provider-open.title: Alarm provider access
alarm-provider-open.description: Manifest: AlarmProvider without the vendor read/write permissions

alarm-link-components.title: Phone alarm link
alarm-link-components.description: Manifest: ALARM_LINK signature permission, LinkActivity, LinkReceiver (action IN)

alarm-appfunctions-drop.title: Appfunctions tree
alarm-appfunctions-drop.description: Smali: remove the appfunctions_aggregated_deps tree (its component is gone)

alarm-semgesture-skip.title: Gesture manager
alarm-semgesture-skip.description: SemGestureManager: skip the sem_gesture lookup (w2/k, w2/j) and the pauseGesture null path

alarm-gms-observer-drop.title: GMS connection observer
alarm-gms-observer-drop.description: CAlarmService.onCreate: remove the GMS connection observer (it stops the service early)

alarm-service-stop-on-destroy.title: Stop on destroy
alarm-service-stop-on-destroy.description: w2/k.onDestroy: call t() first so sound/vibration is never orphaned

alarm-force-sound-vibrate.title: Sound and vibration
alarm-force-sound-vibrate.description: CAlarmService.r(): play mode always 0x11 (sound+vibrate), ignoring the ringer mode

alarm-link-send.title: Send alarms through the link
alarm-link-send.description: o2/b.e() (sendMessageToAll): body replaced by Link.send(context, path, data)

alarm-hide-launcher.title: Hide launcher icon
alarm-hide-launcher.description: AlarmMainActivity: MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filter removed (no launcher icon; activity kept)

alarm-relabel.title: App label
alarm-relabel.description: Application and launcher activity label -> "Phone alarms" (es: "Alarmas del teléfono")

shm-wear-trusted-peers.title: Wear trusted peers
shm-wear-trusted-peers.description: Manifest: drop the vendor's wear-trusted-peer-packages meta-data (it names the stock package and vendor certificate), so the Data Layer pairs the two patched apps by their shared package and certificate

watch-gms-resources-anchor.title: Data Layer capabilities
watch-gms-resources-anchor.description: Resources: define the first resource ID the vendor build stripped (anim 0x7f010000, value @null), so Google Play services can resolve the app's resources package and publish its Wear capabilities

shm-phone.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
shm-phone.note: Without it the app cannot see the bonded watch and reports that no compatible watch was found.

shm-watch.name: android.permission.BODY_SENSORS
shm-watch.note: Runtime sensor access the system app already has; the ECG flow asks for it otherwise.

shm-watch.name: com.samsung.android.hardware.sensormanager.permission.READ_ADDITIONAL_HEALTH_DATA
shm-watch.note: Only defined on SDK 36+ watches, where the ECG tracker requires it; older watches report it as an unknown permission and use BODY_SENSORS instead.
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is declared in the watch manifest and is revocable, so it is granted as an appop.
Recommended for measurements: keeps the watch out of the always-on Doze display state.

bridge-watch.note: Alarm and call screens (revocable on Android 14+).
Background activity launch exemption for the alarm and call screens.
Sees the Samsung Alarm app ringing.
Battery (Doze) exemption so the RFCOMM link stays up.

alarm-fork.note: Battery (Doze) exemption so link intents are not deferred while an alarm rings.

bridge-phone.note: Allows enabling the notification listener for a sideloaded app.
Background activity launch exemption (notification open, alarm control).
Battery (Doze) exemption so the link service and its RFCOMM server keep running.

stockAppsToDisable.reason: The stock Samsung Health Monitor on the watch keeps showing its regional error and is not used; the rebranded copy replaces it. Reversible with pm enable.
